A note from the tower

Good radio
belongs to
everyone.

Signal Tower is an imaginary home for the sounds that fall between stations: left-field records, neighborhood stories, and the magic of someone playing you a song you didn’t know you needed.

No algorithms. Just people, records, and a little bit of static.
